Definition: from G2598; a deposition, i.e. founding; figuratively, conception:--conceive, foundation.
BiblicalUsage: The foundation of the world is where the Bible starts the story before the story starts, chosen in Him before it was laid, hidden in parables since it was laid, and written in the Lamb's book since it was laid. It is the fixed point behind everything, the moment when God had already decided what He would do. Whatever I face now was already inside His plan before the first day ever dawned.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my salvation does not start with me, because God chose before the foundation of the world and the Lamb was slain before it too. I hold that this is the deepest comfort there is: nothing about my life caught God by surprise, and nothing can undo what He settled before the beginning.
